[[Nicholas the Traveler]] }} [[Frigid Heart]]s are cores of stone and coal within the chests of the [[Ice Imp]]s that populate the [[Shiverpeak Mountains]]. Even after the Imp is slain, the heart can remain cold for weeks, regardless of how warm the environment. ==Acquisition== * [[Guild Wars Prophecies|Prophecies]] ** [[Southern Shiverpeaks]] *** [[Ice Imp]] *[[Guild Wars Eye of the North|Eye of the North]] ** [[Far Shiverpeaks]] and [[Depths of Tyria]] *** Ice Imp {{ongoing item research}} [[File:Frigid-Hearts-Floe.jpg|thumb|right|Farming Ice Imps in [[Ice Floe]]]] ===Farming=== Ice Imps are notable for their use of Water Magic, specifically [[Maelstrom]] and [[Mind Freeze]]. Consider spreading out your [[party]] to avoid being consistently [[interrupt]]ed. General [[anti-caster]], [[List of hex removal skills|hex removal]], and/or [[spell targeting prevention]] skills are effective against them. [[File:Frigid-Hearts-Talus.jpg|thumb|right|Farming Ice Imps in [[Talus Chute]]]] ==== [[Ice Floe]] ==== Start from [[Marhan's Grotto]] and follow the eastern path along the coast and you will find exclusively Ice Imps up until the end of the route indicated in the wiki map. Commonly, groups will consist of three to four Ice Imps, with one particularly sizable group that can be found about halfway through. On average, a full run of the route indicated will net you 4-12 Frigid Hearts. ==== [[Talus Chute]] ==== Start from [[Ice Caves of Sorrow (outpost)|Ice Caves of Sorrow]] and follow the path down the mountain, turning left as you cross the bridge. The groups of Ice Imps here are greater in size, and may be difficult to farm on your own. Following this route, you can expect to receive 2-6 Frigid Hearts on average. ==Collectors== {{:Cember Goreaxe/Collector}} {{:Turlo Oakenspear/Collector armor}} {{:Dark Priest Shadowvein/Collector}} {{:Nicholas the Traveler/Collector|21st November 2011 and 1st October 2012|Spearhead Peak|3 [[Frigid Heart]]s}} ==Notes== *The collector [[Cember Goreaxe]] trades 5 Frigid Hearts for items that sell for 125 {{gold}} to a merchant. This provides a return that is over three times more than just selling the trophies by themselves. [[Category:Profitable trophies]] [[Category:Items requested during Wintersday]]
